hooks.text: 鼠标光标始终处于行动中心，主动摧毁、收集并在每局持续变强
hooks.excerpt: Your cursor stays at the center of the action as you actively destroy, collect, and grow stronger every run.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 升级可组合连锁闪电、环绕球、爆炸、光束、治疗与连锁反应
hooks.excerpt: Unlock upgrades that transform your build with chain lightning, orbiting orbs, explosions, beams, healing effects, and powerful chain reactions.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 生成助手与产出生物质的Minicore，维护网络加速整体成长
hooks.excerpt: Spawn helper units, grow biomass-producing Minicores, and maintain your evolving network to accelerate your progression.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 简单玩法仍营造出有效氛围

excerpts.excerpt: the atmosphere is surprisingly effective for such a simple game
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 每阶段强制重置破坏乐趣

excerpts.excerpt: you are being forced to reset everytime the moment the "fun" begin
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 需要持续主动照看关卡且不好玩

excerpts.excerpt: requires a lot of active babysitting to play levels and that's not fun
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: overall the game was too short in my opinion

opinions.text: 最终机制刚融合时游戏就结束

opinions.text: 作为增量游戏玩法有变化
